instructions_to_main_agent: Use static Astro or React components cleanly styled with Tailwind CSS.
Preserve original brand identity (#0056A7 and official logo URL), but give it a high-end Norwegian clinical feel with crisp typography and generous spacing.
Navigation bar must include links to Home, Kurs/undervisning, Forskning/utvikling, Om oss, Ansatte, Kontakt, and Personvernerklæring with data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Footer must clearly highlight St. Olavs hospital & NTNU partnership, contact information, and quick links.
Contact form must be functional in UI with validation and clear confirmation states (data-testid included for submission testing).
Ensure total responsive fidelity on mobile, tablet, and high-DPI desktop viewports.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-link-kurs', data-testid='contact-form-submit-button').
Header must use glassmorphism with backdrop blur and visible navigation links on desktop viewports.
Do not use dark gradients for main background surfaces; default to crisp light surfaces (#F8FAFC and pure white #FFFFFF) with dark navy contrast elements.
Text contrast must adhere to WCAG AA / APCA guidelines with minimum 4.5:1 ratio for standard text.
All page headings must follow Plus Jakarta Sans font and maintain strict size ceilings (H1 max text-5xl to text-6xl on desktop).
